{{Quote|We are ''indeed'' a religious order. We worship the Left-Handed God. The Soulworm. The Lady with the Locust Heart. We worship ''evil,'' my handsome child. We are ''Five.'' This is the place where you will die.|Suzal, to Han Solo|<ref name="TPE" />}}
The '''Five''' was an obscure evil-worshipping cult that existed on a [[Five's warship|warship]] residing deep within the region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] called the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]] within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. Consisting of five [[Human/Legends|humans]] who had managed to survive for [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] away from the concerns of the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the Five amused themselves by [[Torture/Legends|tormenting]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] travelers who had the misfortune of falling into their grasp. One of their most notable captures was [[Wutzek]], the last known living [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]], an immensely powerful being that the Five kept trapped in their recreation room. Their reign of terror ended during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when one of their final [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]]&mdash;[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]&mdash;freed Wutzek and allowed him to slaughter the Five.

==Description==
{{Quote|Who are we? We are five&hellip; five pensive and enlightened souls who have chosen to leave the whirling maelstrom of universal life&hellip; retiring to this, our humble home beyond the dimensions, where we may rest throughout the centuries and pursue our sacred calling.|Suzal|<ref name="TPE" />}}
[[File:Five_warship.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Five's unique warship.]]
The Five was a small cult of five [[Human/Legends|humans]] who lived in the [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] leading up to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and had left behind the concerns of the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] in order to dedicate their lives to the worship of evil in all its forms&mdash;the [[Left-Handed God]], the [[Soulworm]] and the [[Lady with the Locust Heart]] were some of the dark deities the Five venerated. Although the Five viewed themselves as enlightened beings, its members&mdash;[[Suzal]], [[Mavin]], [[Chell (human)|Chell]], [[Chokla]] and [[Koobaree]]&mdash;made sport of brutal violence. The Five resided on a large, triangular [[Five's warship|warship]] that lay in wait for travelers within the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]],<ref name="TPE" /> a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> near [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]].<ref name="TPE" />

The warship was constructed of almost impossible geometries and angles, and could seemingly disappear at will into a realm that the Five called "beyond the dimensions". The Five ensnared approaching [[Starship/Legends|ships]] within a large hole in the center of the warship, and once they had their prey in hand made amusement of [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] captives in agonizing ways. They took special pleasure in psychologically breaking their [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]] through incredibly lifelike illusions, before destroying their bodies with obscure, powerful weapons called [[black fireclaw]]s. However, the Five did not kill every living thing it happened upon: the group had a recreation room aboard their warship where they kept creatures that they viewed as amusing curiosities, viewing the torture of unintelligent beings as beneath them.<ref name="TPE" />

==History==
{{Quote|How frail your flesh, my tormentors. How transient. And now that it is gone, only your souls survive... within me. Forever.|Wutzek, after slaughtering the Five|<ref name="TPE" />}}
[[File:FiveAttack.jpg|thumb|right|350px|The Five psychologically torment Leia Organa.]]
The Five formed centuries before the Galactic Civil War, retiring to their interdimensional warship in the Hellhoop and dedicating their lives to the worship of evil and the desecration of unfortunate travelers. Over time, they also built up a substantial collection of captive creatures in their recreation room&mdash;none more formidable than [[Wutzek]], the last known living [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]]. A member of a [[Species/Legends|species]] that had ruled the galaxy during its dawn age, Wutzek was tricked and imprisoned for decades in a device called an [[angle trap]], becoming one of the favored exhibitions in the Five's zoo. Over the generations, the Five's presence lended the Hellhoop a black reputation among [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]]&mdash;although the cult itself remained obscure, tales traveled about a region of space where ships frequently disappeared, and most advised to avoid the area.<ref name="TPE" />

The Five continued its reign of terror within the Hellhoop until sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when the cultists welcomed their final guests. When [[Torgaigne]] gangsters from nearby Attahox chased [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] into the Hellhoop over a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] dispute, the Five ensnared both sides of the conflict, immediately putting the Torgaignes to death and psychologically torturing Solo and Organa. However, the Five made one crucial mistake: not recognizing the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] as a sentient being, they placed what they thought was a simple [[Ape/Legends|ape]] in its recreation room with the other curiosities. Chewbacca easily escaped his bindings and was [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathically]] convinced to free Wutzek, who rampaged through the ship and killed all five members of the cult. Wutzek then absorbed their [[Soul/Legends|souls]] into his body, and after allowing the Rebels to escape, utterly destroyed the cult's ship and removed all trace of their existence.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Five appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]].<ref name="TPE" />
